watches.name: Crafter Blue Mechanic Ocean Mark II MO2SS007.HK (Limited 30pcs)(Sold out)
watches.description: Feature: Date Screw-in crown Unidirectional rotating bezel with 120 clicks DLC coated bezel insert Swiss Super-LumiNova BGW9 Description: HK DIVER WATCH GROUP X CRAFTER BLUE MECHANIC OCEAN MARK II Founded in 2016, HK Diver Watch Group is committed to promoting diving watches in Asia. Today, the community has reached 12,000 people. At the end of this year, Crafter Blue and HK Diver Watch Group joined forces for the first time to launch the Mechanic Ocean Mark II limited edition, limited to 30 pieces only. The Mechanic Ocean Mark II is a professional diver’s watch that blends retro style with modern functionality. Designed with the precision and durability that divers expect, this timepiece offers a sleek, mid-sized profile without compromising on ruggedness or elegance. With a diameter of just 41mm and a thickness of 13.50mm, the Mechanic Ocean Mark II strikes a perfect balance between comfort and robust durability. Whether The slim profile adds a touch of elegance, making it versatile for both professional and everyday wear. The Mechanic Ocean Mark II's bezel stands out as one of the watch’s most defining features. Crafted with layered detailing, the bezel insert is coated with DLC coating and features rounded-circle indexes, adding to its distinctive look. At 12 o’clock, a large blue lume ensures sharp visibility even in the darkest underwater conditions. Powered by the reliable Miyota 9015 movement, the Mechanic Ocean Mark II is built for precision. This high-end movement offers 28,800 vibrations per hour, providing smooth, precise timekeeping. The Mechanic Ocean Mark II is designed to meet the rigorous demands of underwater exploration. A water resistance rating of 300 meters ensures exceptional performance under extreme conditions. Whether you are a professional diver or an ocean researcher, you can rely on this timepiece to provide accurate and dependable timekeeping during your underwater ventures. watches.name: CRAFTER BLUE BON VOYAGE Macaron Super Chrono BVSS002.M (Discontinued)
watches.description: The Macaron Super Chrono stands out from its counterparts thanks to several noteworthy features that reflect Crafter Blue's commitment to innovation and quality craftsmanship. Let's explore some of the key highlights that define this remarkable timepiece. At the heart of the Macaron Super Chrono's allure lies its captivating macaron color scheme. The chronograph and 24-hour sub-dials are adorned with delightful shades, with the chrono eye sporting a soothing baby blue hue, while the 24-hour eye boasts a charming light yellow tone. Against the backdrop of the deep blue rugged texture dial, these vibrant colors create a striking visual contrast that immediately captures attention. Moreover, the indexes are coated with Swiss Super-LumiNova old radium lume, ensuring optimal visibility even in low-light conditions. The result is a face that exudes rugged vintage elegance, perfectly complementing the watch's overall aesthetic. Despite drawing inspiration from vintage pilot watches, the Macaron Super Chrono incorporates cutting-edge technology to deliver unparalleled accuracy and reliability. Powering this timepiece is the Seiko VK64 advanced quartz chronograph movement, renowned for its precision and performance. Notably, the absence of a second’s hand eliminates the distracting ticking motion typically associated with quartz movements, lending the dial a cleaner and more refined appearance. Furthermore, the VK series features a hybrid mechanical chronograph structure, which ensures a smooth and mechanical-like movement of the chronograph seconds hand, capable of instant reset in a counterclockwise direction. This blend of traditional aesthetics and modern functionality makes the Macaron Super Chrono a true masterpiece of horological engineering.

watches.name: CRAFTER BLUE HYPERION OCEAN CHRONOGRAPH ARCTIC BLUE HOCSS002.SB.R (Discontinued)
watches.description: Feature: Chronograph Date Screw-in crown Unidirectional rotating bezel Technical Data: Case: 316L stainless steel Case Diameter: 42mm Case Back: Stainless steel back Dial color: Sun-brushed blue Crystal: Domed sapphire crystal Thickness: 16.90mm Lug width: 20mm Movement: Seiko NE86 Chronograph movement (stop-seconds function, 28,800 vibrations, chronograph function with a vertical clutch and column wheel), same as Seiko movement 8R48 Water Resistance: 200m / 600ft Description: The Hyperion Ocean Chronograph Arctic Blue, bringing a sense of coolness to this hot summer, while also conveying a significant message about global warming. Rising temperatures have caused the sea ice in the Arctic Ocean to decrease by 10% every decade, with the ice becoming thinner and the overall volume decreasing, leading to an increase in the frequency of severe weather. CRAFTER BLUE has always prioritized ocean issues and hopes to deepen the discussion on environmental protection through this watch. The Hyperion Ocean Chronograph Arctic Blue inherits the essence of this series and is a dual-use watch for sailing and diving. It also features the SEIKO NE86 mechanical chronograph movement and comes with a 30-minute counter. The bezel is divided into orange, blue, and gray sections to indicate the timing intervals. It has a water resistance of up to 200 meters, a sapphire crystal dial, and a sturdy DLC stainless steel bezel. The 42mm diameter is an ideal size when worn on the wrist. The new watch uses the SEIKO NE86 mechanical chronograph movement, which features the vertical clutch device technology first introduced by Seiko in 1969. The NE86 also has a column wheel and Seiko's unique three pointed hammer, which are indispensable structures in current chronographs. As a diving chronograph watch, the hour and minute hands as well as the indexes on the dial are coated with Super-LumiNova. The crown and pushers are equipped with a screw-lock structure, and it has a water resistance of up to 200 meters, making it suitable for various marine professionals, marine researchers, and professional divers.

watches.name: Crafter Blue Hyperion Ocean Chronograph HOCSS007.M.R (Discontinued)
watches.description: The Hyperion Ocean Chronograph extends the Crafter Blue standards of watch making for professional use. Built for ocean researchers and professional divers, it offers a reliable and accurate chronograph timepiece they can rely on in each exploration. The Hyperion Ocean Chronograph features a 42mm body built with quality stainless steel encasing the high-end Seiko NE86 chronograph movement. It embodies harmony of both advanced technologies and contemporary style. With the design of 2 color segments replacing the numerical indication, the Hyperion Ocean Chronograph offers a better comprehension of time reading up to 78%, according to research. Actuation of the start, stop, and return to zero functions is precise and clean with the well-integrated column wheel. The in-built vertical clutch ensures the chronograph second will not jerk on every start of timing. All these subtleties are taken care of with precision in the Hyperion Ocean Chronograph.
